item.title: Charli xcx Unleashes a Moshpit For ‘Rock Music’: Watch
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest music trends. Today, we're talking about Charli XCX, the British singer, songwriter, and producer who's taking the music scene by storm. Her latest release, "Rock Music", is out now, and we're breaking it down for you.
[Music transition]
Host: "Rock Music" is a departure from Charli's usual sound, with a throwback edge and a mid-paced electronic track featuring electric guitars. The music video, directed by Aidan Zamiri, is a wild ride, with Charli getting up to rock 'n' roll antics in central Manhattan.
[Audio clip of "Rock Music" plays in the background]
Host: Charli first teased her new era and sound in an interview with British Vogue, where she shared a lyric from the song: "I think the dance floor is dead, so now we're making rock music." But, as she later clarified on Instagram, this isn't a complete about-face - she's just exploring new possibilities.
[Music transition]
Host: "Rock Music" is Charli's first release since her Wuthering Heights companion album, which debuted at number 8 on the Billboard 200 chart. And, with a busy year ahead, including starring roles in several films, Charli XCX is definitely one to watch.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today. Stream "Rock Music" and watch the official music video now. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next episode!
